45975.subject: Technical Drawing
45975.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a given line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
45975.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc above and below AB with radius greater than half of AB.
3. With B as center, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector of AB.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

45976.subject: Technical Drawing
45976.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
45976.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F on the circumference.
4. Join the points A, B, C, D, E, and F to form the regular hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

45977.subject: Technical Drawing
45977.question_text: Construct a tangent to a given circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center of the circle. Show all construction lines.
45977.explanation:
1. Draw the given circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join O and P.
4. Construct the perpendicular bisector of OP to find its midpoint M.
5. With M as center and radius MO, draw an arc intersecting the circle at points T and T'.
6. Join P to T and P to T' to form the tangents.
7. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

45978.subject: Technical Drawing
45978.question_text: Draw the front, top, and right-side views of the given object in first-angle orthographic projection. The object is a rectangular block 50 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm with a semicircular slot of radius 10 mm cut from the top face along the 50 mm length. Show all hidden details.
45978.explanation:
1. Draw the front view: 50 mm (length) × 20 mm (height) with a semicircular slot of radius 10 mm at the top.
2. Draw the top view: 50 mm (length) × 30 mm (width) with the semicircular slot visible as a rectangle with semicircles at the ends.
3. Draw the right-side view: 30 mm (width) × 20 mm (height) showing the semicircular slot as a hidden detail.
4. Include all hidden lines using dashed lines.
5. Label all views and dimensions clearly.

45979.subject: Technical Drawing
45979.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object, which is a hollow cylinder of outer diameter 60 mm, inner diameter 40 mm, and height 50 mm, cut by a vertical plane passing through its axis. Show all section lines.
45979.explanation:
1. Draw the outer circle of diameter 60 mm and inner circle of diameter 40 mm in the front view.
2. Draw vertical lines to represent the height of 50 mm.
3. Section the object along the vertical plane through the axis.
4. Apply section lines (hatching) to the cut surfaces at 45°.
5. Label all dimensions and section lines clearly.

45980.subject: Technical Drawing
45980.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a rectangular block 60 mm × 40 mm × 30 mm with a circular hole of diameter 20 mm drilled through the center of the top face. Show all hidden details.
45980.explanation:
1. Draw the isometric axes at 30° to the horizontal.
2. Construct the isometric box with dimensions 60 mm (length), 40 mm (width), and 30 mm (height).
3. On the top face, draw an ellipse to represent the circular hole of diameter 20 mm.
4. Show hidden edges of the hole using dashed lines.
5. Label all dimensions and axes clearly.

45981.subject: Technical Drawing
45981.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a right circular cone with base diameter 50 mm and slant height 60 mm. Show all construction lines.
45981.explanation:
1. Draw the base circle of diameter 50 mm.
2. Calculate the circumference of the base: $C = \pi imes 50$ mm.
3. Draw a sector of a circle with radius 60 mm (slant height) and arc length equal to the circumference of the base.
4. The angle of the sector is calculated as $ heta = rac{C}{60} imes rac{180}{\pi}$ degrees.
5. Label all dimensions and construction lines clearly.

45982.subject: Technical Drawing
45982.question_text: Draw the line of intersection between a vertical cylinder of diameter 40 mm and a horizontal cylinder of diameter 30 mm, where the axes intersect at right angles. Show all construction lines.
45982.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of the vertical cylinder (diameter 40 mm) and horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm).
2. In the top view, divide the circumference of the vertical cylinder into 12 equal parts.
3. Project these points to the front view.
4. Draw horizontal lines from the points on the vertical cylinder to intersect the horizontal cylinder in the front view.
5. Join the points of intersection to form the curve of interpenetration.
6. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

45983.subject: Technical Drawing
45983.question_text: Determine the true shape of the section obtained by cutting a right circular cone (base diameter 50 mm, height 60 mm) with an inclined plane passing through the midpoint of the axis and inclined at 45° to the base. Show all construction lines.
45983.explanation:
1. Draw the front and top views of the cone.
2. Draw the inclined plane at 45° in the front view.
3. Divide the base circle into 12 equal parts and project these points to the front view.
4. Find the points of intersection of the inclined plane with the generators of the cone.
5. Project these points to the top view to obtain the true shape of the section.
6. Join the points to form the ellipse representing the true shape.
7. Label all points and construction lines clearly.

45984.subject: Technical Drawing
45984.question_text: Dimension the following orthographic views of a simple bracket: front view (50 mm × 30 mm with a 10 mm diameter hole centered 15 mm from the top edge) and side view (30 mm × 20 mm). Apply standard dimensioning conventions.
45984.explanation:
1. In the front view, dimension the overall height (30 mm) and width (50 mm).
2. Dimension the hole diameter (10 mm) and its vertical position (15 mm from the top edge).
3. In the side view, dimension the overall height (30 mm) and depth (20 mm).
4. Use extension lines, dimension lines, and arrowheads correctly.
5. Place dimensions outside the views where possible and avoid duplication.
6. Label all dimensions clearly.
